# Field
Atlas Field v1 — one form field: a Label, a control, and either help text or an error message, wired together so the label, the control and the message belong to each other for assistive tech. 3 sizes (sm, md, lg) that follow the Label and the control.

USE WHEN
· A form needs a labelled Input, Textarea or Select with help text or a validation message.
· Every field in a form should name its control, mark required or optional, and announce its error the same way.
· The error text must be linked to the control, not shown as colour alone.
DON'T USE WHEN
· A Checkbox, Radio or Switch is the control. They own their own label and description.
· The control is a single search box with no label row. Use Input alone.
· A form-level failure (submit rejected). Use one Alert above the actions.
HOW TO USE
· Pass the control as a render prop; Field hands it id, invalid, disabled, aria-describedby and aria-required, so spread them onto the control.
· Set required or optional, never both and never a typed asterisk; required wins.
· Give helpText for guidance and error for a failed check. The error replaces the help text and sets the Label and control to invalid.
· Match the control size to the Field size (sm, md or lg; Select has sm and md).
· Turn Action on to show a link Button at the end of the label row, for example Forgot password?; edit its text on the nested instance.
· In Figma: turn Help off and Invalid on to show the error; set Required, Optional and the disabled and error states on the nested Label and Control instances.
DO
· Keep the Label visible; never use a placeholder as the label.
· Write the error as what to do next ("Enter a valid email address").
DON'T
· Show an error before the user has touched the field, except after a failed submit.
· Put an Alert in place of a field error.
RELATED
· Label, Input, Textarea, Select. The controls Field wraps.
· Alert. A form-level failure, not a field error.

PROPERTIES
Size: sm | md | lg. Help: boolean (default on). Help text: text. Invalid: boolean (default off). Error text: text. Action: boolean (default off). The Label and the control are nested instances, edited in place.
